question: Which is an uricosuric drug-
analysis: Probenecid is a uricosuric drug that increases the excretion of uric acid in the urine, thereby lowering blood uric acid levels. Allopurinol is a xanthine oxidase inhibitor, Indomethacin is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), and Aspirin, at low doses, can actually reduce uric acid excretion.
